messages:
alex: Quick sync — Lotus on-prem rollout prep. Proposing Thu 10:00am PT for a 60m review. Agenda draft: 1) Network & firewall/IP allowlist 2) KMS/HSM integration 3) Canary plan & rollback criteria 4) Runbook & perf smoke tests 5) Final cutover windows. Who can make it?

mia: 10am PT works for me. Can we add "DB migration plan" and "cert rotation timing" to agenda? Also need list of artifacts we should have ready for the call (configs, cert exports, IP ranges).

julian: I'm on-call that day but can join first 30m to cover DB migration. Add me for the migration checklist. Also: customer is using Postgres 13, want to confirm replication lag thresholds.

sam: Can we also allocate 10m for performance gating? I can run a quick token-rate perf test if we get baseline infra creds. Suggest we define explicit rollback criteria: e.g., 95th p90 latency > X or error rate > Y.

tara: +1 on adding security touches. Please invite Lotus' network engineer and their security lead. We'll need their public IPs for allowlist and a short diagram of their VPC->onprem routing. Also request KMS key alias and key policy preview.

alex: Thanks — noted. Added DB migration, cert rotation, perf gating, security attendees. Preflight checklist snippet below (share in repo before call):

```
- network: customer IPs, firewall rules, MTU
- certs: CSR + CA chain, rotation window
- kms: key alias, kms policy, kms-region
- storage: disk sizes, mountpoints
- migration: replication slot, WAL retention
- smoke-tests: auth, generate, embed sanity
```

alex: Can folks drop any required docs into /shared/lotus/onprem-preflight (or paste links) by EOD Wed so we can review ahead of the call? If not, we'll keep those as blockers on the agenda.

mia: Dropping network diagram and cert CSR now: https://redwood.internal/drive/lotus/network-diagram

deploy-bot: Meeting created -> https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/7e3b-lotus-rollout (Thu 10:00am PT, 60m). Invite includes: alex, mia, julian, sam, tara, lotus-netops, lotus-security. Auto-attached agenda draft.

julian: Confirmed. I'll prepare the DB migration runbook section and post small checklist by Wed evening.

sam: I'll queue a quick perf run in staging tonight and share baseline numbers in thread.

tara: I'll request IPs from Lotus and share once I have them. If they can't provide full list in time, we should schedule a short pre-call with their network team.

alex: Sounds good. Agenda locked for Thu 10:00am PT unless anyone objects. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
